newsitem.title: USA: Talley, GM's Delphi sign airbag pact.
newsitem.headline: Talley, GM's Delphi sign airbag pact.

text.p: Talley Industries Inc. and General Motors Corp's Delphi Automotive Systems said Thursday they agreed to form a strategic alliance to make advanced auto airbag inflators.

Phoenix, Ariz.-based Talley will own a majority of the proposed joint venture, which will consist of a manufacturing company and development agreement. Cooperative activities will be accomplished through Delphi Interior & Lighting System and Talley Defense Systems.

The venture will primarily make inflators for Delphi's airbag module products and other airbag module suppliers. The first product will be an all pyrotechnic, non-sodium azide driver-side inflator that could be available in early 1998.

The joint venture is scheduled to break ground this year on a new production facility in the Phoenix area that would be capable of producing 10 million inflators annually. A Talley spokesman could not provide details about the size of the plant or its potential workforce.
Final approval of the alliance is contingent on a definitive agreement being negotiated.
